items.title: General Dynamics (GD) Stock Looks Reasonable After Its 119% Five Year Run
items.summary: General Dynamics stock has delivered a 119.4% total return over the past 5 years, yet current checks suggest it may still trade below an estimate of intrinsic value based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model and supporting market multiples. Recent headlines around new U.S. government contracts and operational issues at a Texas factory mean investors are weighing that valuation gap against execution and reputational risks. items.summary: General Dynamics (NYSE: GD) appointed Danny Deep to its board of directors after more than 20 years with the company. items.title: Iran disputes Qatar, Kuwait accounts as U.S. war commander visits carrier

items.title: 3 Industrials Stocks That Concern Us
items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities.
